title: I built an Old-School 3rd Person MMO Engine & Mod Kit inside Spawn (5,600+ models, combat, world editor) Alpha 0.5.9
author: camptons_world
selftext:
I just packaged the entire system into an importable modular mod kit: the **Old School + 3rd Person MMO Kit**.

**What’s packed inside:**

* 🏰 **5,600+ Optimized 3D Models:** Castles, shrines, flora, dungeons, mounts, and monster rigs ready to drop onto your terrain.
* ✨ **Thousands of VFX & Animations:** Classic spell schools (Fireball, Frost Nova, Arcane Missiles), combat swings, casts, and death loops.
* ⚔️ **Complete Action RPG Framework:** Unit frames, classic stats/attributes, threat-based looting, enemy spawners, and dialogue trees with custom NPCs.
* 🛠️ **Full World Editor & Discovery Hub:** Fly around in Build Mode, sculpt living terrain, save your layouts, and export/import worlds via quick share codes

You can drop the mod straight into any [spawn.co/](http://spawn.co/) project or hop in to explore, build, and fight right now

Check it out live: [**https://www.spawn.co/?box=@camptons\_world/realmcrafter**](https://www.spawn.co/?box=@camptons_world/realmcrafter)

Drop any feedback, bug reports, or feature ideas below—what classic class or mechanic should get added next!

comments.author: because-potato
comments.body: Does it make the backend any simpler? I struggled greatly with multiplayer in unity. I would love to try something out that simplifies multiplayer.

replies.author: camptons_world
replies.body: Spawn handles backend by default :) Free Agent all day.
